message: feat: reject too-short pasted job text in apply-kit parse
post:
Building ApplyOS (applyos.io) means handling a lot of unstructured text. A recent challenge was parsing pasted job descriptions.

We want to extract key details like job title, company, and location. But what happens when the user pastes something too brief? We risk misinterpreting or failing silently.

This led to adding a simple length check. If the pasted text is under 20 characters, we reject it upfront. It’s a small guardrail, but it improves the reliability of the parsing logic that follows.

How do you handle obviously invalid input in your parsing flows?
alt: A TypeScript code block that checks if the length of the sourceText variable is less than 20 and returns a JSON error response if it is.
